source.dataset: Natural Earth 1:50m Cultural Vectors — Admin 0 Countries
source.licence: Public Domain (Natural Earth Terms of Use)

steps: read GeoJSON with Python's json module
projected nothing: coordinates are stored as quantised lon/lat in 1/200 degrees
dropped consecutive duplicate vertices and rings with fewer than 3 points
dropped holes smaller than the minimum ring area
capital names joined from ne_50m_populated_places_simple by adm0_a3 where adm0cap=1
ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 accepted only when the source value is a plain code; else stored as null
search keys folded to lowercase ASCII in the pipeline

known_limitations: 1:50m generalisation: coastlines and borders are simplified for world-scale display.
Quantised to 0.005 degrees; sub-pixel detail below that resolution is intentionally lost.
Natural Earth's map unit for Palestine is TYPE 'Indeterminate' with SOVEREIGNT 'Israel'; both source fields are preserved verbatim and no stance is taken.
Disputed and dependent territories keep Natural Earth's TYPE/SOVEREIGNT/NOTE values; no sovereignty is inferred by this project.
Population, GDP and income fields from the source are deliberately not imported.
